title: Complete Namo Bharat RRTS Fare Guide 2026
description: Everything you need to know about Namo Bharat RRTS fares — standard, premium, and Meerut Metro pricing explained.
body:
The Delhi to Meerut Namo Bharat RRTS became fully operational on 22 February 2026. This guide covers everything you need to know about fares on the network, including official verified fares from NCRTC, Meerut Metro pricing, how the fare structure works, payment methods, and concessions. All prices below are for Standard Coach, one way, unless stated otherwise.

Use the fare calculator below to get an instant estimate for your journey, or scroll down for the complete official fare tables sourced directly from NCRTC.

## Namo Bharat Fare Calculator

Select your starting station and destination to check the fare instantly.

| Maximum fare, Sarai Kale Khan to Modipuram (Standard) | ₹210 |
| Maximum fare, Sarai Kale Khan to Modipuram (Premium) | ₹250 |

For detailed Namo Bharat RRTS fares, see our [complete guide](https://metroguideindia.com/fares).

## How Namo Bharat RRTS Fares Work

Namo Bharat fares are distance based, meaning the fare increases as the distance between your origin and destination station grows. Unlike a simple per kilometre rate, fares are set in bands, so two journeys of similar distance can sometimes have slightly different fares depending on where they fall within NCRTC's official fare table. This is a common approach across Indian metro and rapid transit systems and is not unique to Namo Bharat.

There are two travel classes. Standard Coach is the regular fare shown throughout this guide. Premium Coach costs roughly 20 percent more and offers extra comfort, with the premium coach positioned at one end of the train.

## Meerut Metro Fares

Meerut Metro is the local service running within Meerut city on the same track as Namo Bharat, using a shared "one track, two services" model. Meerut Metro fares are lower than RRTS fares since it is designed for shorter, local trips within the city rather than intercity travel. Fares range from ₹10 to ₹60 depending on distance.

## Namo Bharat Fare vs Meerut Metro Fare: Why the Difference?

Commuters often ask why the same distance costs more on Namo Bharat than on Meerut Metro. The answer comes down to purpose and comfort. Namo Bharat trains run at up to 160 km/h with aircraft style seating and are built for longer intercity distances, while Meerut Metro is a local service with more frequent stops designed for shorter trips within the city. The higher Namo Bharat fare reflects the higher speed, extra comfort, and the fact that it covers Delhi to Meerut intercity travel rather than only local Meerut journeys.

## How to Pay for Namo Bharat Tickets

Namo Bharat uses a fully digital, QR code based ticketing system with several payment options:

- Station ticket counters, for cash or card payment
- Ticket Vending Machines (TVMs) available at every station
- Namo Bharat Connect app, where you can book a QR ticket using UPI, card, or wallet, and also track live train timings
- NCMC or RuPay Smart Cards, which allow tap in and tap out at all stations without buying a fresh ticket each time

## Concessions and Discounts

- Children under 90 cm in height travel free on both RRTS and Meerut Metro
- RRTS minimum fare is ₹20 for Standard Coach and ₹30 for Premium Coach
- Meerut Metro minimum fare is ₹10
- NCMC Smart Card is accepted at all stations across both RRTS and Meerut Metro

## Tips to Save on Namo Bharat Fares

- Use an NCMC card instead of buying single QR tickets if you travel regularly, since tap in and tap out is faster and avoids repeated booking
- Standard Coach is sufficient for most journeys. Premium Coach is worth the extra cost mainly on the longer Meerut bound trips rather than short hops
- If your journey involves both Namo Bharat and Meerut Metro, remember these are priced and ticketed separately, so factor in both fares when budgeting a full trip to stations like Meerut North or Modipuram

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is the minimum fare on Namo Bharat RRTS?

The minimum fare is ₹20 for Standard Coach and ₹30 for Premium Coach.

#### What is the maximum fare on Namo Bharat RRTS?

The highest fare on the network is for the full Sarai Kale Khan to Modipuram journey, priced at ₹210 for Standard Coach and ₹250 for Premium Coach.

#### Is the fare the same in both directions?

Yes. Namo Bharat fares are the same regardless of direction of travel between any two stations.

#### Do children need a ticket on Namo Bharat?

Children under 90 cm in height travel free on both Namo Bharat RRTS and Meerut Metro.

#### Is there a monthly pass for Namo Bharat?

NCRTC has not announced a monthly pass as of now. The most convenient option for regular commuters is an NCMC Smart Card, which allows quick tap in and tap out without booking individual tickets.

#### Why is Meerut Metro cheaper than Namo Bharat RRTS?

Meerut Metro is a local service designed for shorter trips within Meerut city, while Namo Bharat RRTS is built for faster, longer intercity travel between Delhi and Meerut, which is reflected in its higher fare.

#### Can I use the same ticket for Namo Bharat and Meerut Metro?

No. Namo Bharat RRTS and Meerut Metro are ticketed separately, even though they share the same track through Meerut city. You will need a separate ticket or tap in and tap out for each service.

#### How can I check the fare between two stations not listed here?

Use the fare calculator on this page, or check the Namo Bharat Connect app for the exact fare between any two stations on the network.

Source: NCRTC official data via meerutmetro.in, February 2026. Fares can be revised by NCRTC from time to time. Always verify current fares at the station or on the Namo Bharat Connect app before travel.
